title: OpAuditLogResponse
description:
Public-facing audit-log entry returned by the audit HTTP route. Omits
token_hash — never includes any token material — and carries the credential
reference plus non-secret target metadata only.

profileId.description: Authentication profile associated with the operation, or null.

secretRef.description: The alias or op:// reference requested. Never a resolved value.

targetOrigin.description: Document origin the fill was attempted on, or null.

targetSelector.description: CSS selector supplied by the caller, or null.

targetDescriptor.description: Non-secret descriptor of the focused element, or null.

errorCode.description: Error code when the outcome is `failure`, otherwise null.
